title: sacdj's Pickaxe Game Additions
description: Made for pickaxe game on the DiamondFire server. currently changes coal blocks to be more obvious among other black blocks
body:
These are my addtions for the game "Pickaxe Game" from sputt on the DiamondFire Server

Current additions
- Coal block indecation to make it easyer to spot a coal block in the blackstone layer!
- Moon door clock frames to make sure u are at the door when it opens!
- Polished blackstone bricks have a an animated indecator like coal block (different colors)
- Moon door key has animated texture (changed tripwire hook)

if u have any ideas for wat to make more in the pack plz let me know!
